;///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
; This file let's you change Maavo's settings to your liking
;///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

[Statedef 5900]
type = S	

[State 5900, 1] ;Clear all int variables
type = VarRangeSet
trigger1 = !roundsexisted && matchno = 1
value = 0

[State 5900, 2] ;Clear all float variables
type = VarRangeSet
trigger1 = !roundsexisted && matchno = 1
fvalue = 0

;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DO NOT EDIT ANYTHING ABOVE THIS LINE
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ____   _____   _____   _____   ___    _   _    ____    ____  
;/ ___| | ____| |_   _| |_   _| |_ _|  | \ | |  / ___|  / ___| 
;\___ \ |  _|     | |     | |    | |   |  \| | | |  _   \___ \ 
; ___) || |___    | |     | |    | |   | |\  | | |_| |   ___) |
;|____/ |_____|   |_|     |_|   |___|  |_| \_|  \____|  |____/ 
																								[State 5900, Config Settings]
																								type = Null
;=================================================================================================
;Input Type?
;				 ___________________________________________________________
;				|0 - Normal (QCF inputs only, one version per move, no EX   |
;				|    variants)                                              |
;				|1 - Alternative (more complex inputs, two versions for most| 
;				|    moves, some moves have EX versions)                    |    
;            			|                                                           |
trigger1 = 0&&var(19):=		(0) ; ◄ Change value here.                                  |
;				 ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾

;=================================================================================================
;Assist X Pos?
;				 ___________________________________________________________
trigger2 = 0&&var(13):=		(5) ; ◄ Change value here.                                  |
;				|                                                           |
;Assist Y Pos?			|                                                           |
trigger3 = 0&&var(14):=		(48) ; ◄ Change value here.                                 |
;				 ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾

;=================================================================================================
;Screen Resolution?
;				 ___________________________________________________________
;				|0 - Widescreen (16:9)                                      |
;				|1 - Normal Screen (4:3)                                    |
;				|2 - Auto                                                   |
;            			|                                                           |
trigger4 = 0&&var(17):=		(2) ; ◄ Change value here.                                  |
;				 ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾

;=================================================================================================
;Voice Language?
;				 ___________________________________________________________
;				|0 - Spanish                                                |
;				|1 - English                                                |
;            			|                                                           |
trigger5 = 0&&var(16):=		(0) ; ◄ Change value here.                                  |
;				 ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾

;=================================================================================================
;Text Language? (Victory Quotes are only available on Spanish and English) 
;				 ___________________________________________________________
;				|0 - Spanish                                                |
;				|1 - English                                                |
;				|2 - Japanese                                               |
;				|3 - Portuguese                                             |
;				|4 - Russian                                                |
;				|5 - Italian                                                |
;            			|                                                           |
trigger6 = 0&&var(20):=		(1) ; ◄ Change value here.                                  |
;				 ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾

;=================================================================================================
;Maritza/Ivette voices?
;				 ___________________________________________________________
;				|0 - 2026 voices (L1llian_V1sual & Flanmby)                 |
;				|1 - Legacy voices (Riusaki Fujioka & Miki)                 |
;            			|                                                           |
trigger7 = 0&&var(34):=		(0) ; ◄ Change value here.                                  |
;				 ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾

;=================================================================================================
;Victory BGM? (Certain opponents and palettes will force a specific theme to play.)
;				 ___________________________________________________________
;				|0: N/A                                                     |
;				|1: Victory! (Showtime) by Kakow0 (Default)                 |
;				|2: Victory! (Old) by Rossiter                              |
;				|3: Victory! (Old) by Rossiter (Short) > Results Screen -   |
;				|    Super Smash Brothers for 3DS and Wii U                 |
;				|4: After the Battle - Persona 3                            |
;				|5: Period - Persona 4                                      |
;				|6: Triumph - Persona 5                                     |
;				|7: Random                                                  |
;            			|                                                           |
trigger8 = 0&&var(52):=		(1) ; ◄ Change value here.                                  |
;				 ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾

;=================================================================================================
;Scrapped Moves? (This will enable 2 scrapped special moves)
;				 ___________________________________________________________
;				|0 - Off                                                    |
;				|1 - On                                                     |
;            			|                                                           |
trigger9 = 0&&var(39):=		(0) ; ◄ Change value here.                                  |
;			
ignorehitpause = 1
;------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DO NOT EDIT ANYTHING BELOW THIS LINE
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[State 0, Null]
type = Null
trigger1 = teammode = simul
trigger1 = !numpartner || numpartner && (partner,id > id)
trigger1 = 0&&(fvar(10):=0)
trigger2 = teammode = simul
trigger2 = numpartner && (partner,id < id)
trigger2 = partner,name = "Maavo"
trigger2 = 0&&(fvar(10):=1)
ignorehitpause = 1

[State 5900, Palette Selector]
type = VarSet
trigger1 = 1
fv = 37
value = 1

; If value = 1 Palette Selector is ON
; If value = 0 Palette Selector is OFF 
 
 
[State 5900, Pal Selector on]
type=helper
triggerall=fvar(37)&&!numhelper(12345)&&!AILevel&&numenemy 
trigger1= roundno = 1 && matchno=1 && !(teammode = simul) && !(enemy, teammode = simul)
trigger2= !fvar(36) 
trigger3=(teammode = turns)
trigger3=!roundsexisted && (enemy,roundsexisted)
id=12345
stateno=12345
facing=facing
ownpal=1
size.xscale = .25
size.yscale = .25

[state 5900, No Palette selector]
type = remappal
trigger1 = !fvar(37)||AILevel
source = 1, 1
dest = 1, palno
ignorehitpause = 1

[State 5900, 4] ;Intro for round 1
type = ChangeState
trigger1 = roundno = 1
trigger2 = !RoundsExisted
trigger2 = teammode = Turns
value = 190

[State 5900, 5] ;All other rounds
type = ChangeState
trigger1 = 1
value = 0

;This is the palette selector helper (statedef 12345)
;You can change the animation size using the x-y scales.

[Statedef 12345]
physics = N
anim = 12345
velset=0,0
sprpriority=99999
 
[State 12345, PosSet]
type = PosSet
trigger1 =!time 
x = root,facing*-90
y = 25
ignorehitpause = 1
 
[State 12345, AS]
type=assertspecial
trigger1=1
flag=intro
flag2=noshadow

[State 12345, Reset]
type=varset
trigger1=!time
fvar(38)=200

[State 12345, Pal]
type=varset
trigger1=!time
fvar(36)=root,palno
 
[State 12345, Varset]
type=varset
trigger1=fvar(36)<1||fvar(36)>52 ; last palette
fvar(36)=1+(fvar(36)<1)*51 ; subtract -1 from your last palette
 
[State 12345, PlaySnd]
type = PlaySnd
trigger1 =fvar(39)=2 
value = S12345,0
volumescale = 100
channel = 20

[State 12345, PlaySnd]
type = PlaySnd
triggerall=ishelper(12345)
trigger1=root,command="a"||root,command="b"||root,command="c"||root,command="x"||root,command="y"||root,command="z"||root,command="start"||roundstate=2
value = S12345,1
volumescale = 100
channel = 20
persistent =0 
 
[State 12345, Countdown]
type = VarAdd
trigger1 =1 
fvar(38)=-1

[State 12345, Countdown]
type = VarAdd
trigger1=!fvar(39)&&fvar(38)<150
trigger1=root,command="holdup"||root,command="holddown"||root,command="holdback"||root,command="holdfwd"
fvar(38)=25
 
[State 12345, Varadd]
type=varadd
trigger1=!fvar(39)
trigger1=root,command="holdup"||root,command="holddown"||root,command="holdback"||root,command="holdfwd"
fvar(36)=1-(root,command="holddown"||root,command="holdback"&&facing=1||root,command="holdfwd"&&facing=-1)*2
 
[State 12345, Varadd]
type=varadd
trigger1=(root,command="holdup"||root,command="holddown"||root,command="holdback"||root,command="holdfwd")&&!fvar(39)||fvar(39)
fvar(39)=1
 
[State 12345, Varset]
type=varset
trigger1=!time||fvar(39)>=17
fvar(39)=0
 
[State 12345, End]
type=destroyself
triggerall=ishelper(12345)
trigger1=root,command="a"||root,command="b"||root,command="c"||root,command="x"||root,command="y"||root,command="z"||root,command="start"||roundstate=2
trigger2=root,AILevel
